The North Ridge is a moderate, less-traveled alternative to the South Buttress: an 8-pitch, roughly 600-foot Grade III 5.7 ridge climb first done by Fred Beckey, Jim Crooks, and Ed Kenney on August 19, 1940.

face: Dolomite Tower, north face amphitheatre (Mt. Baring massif)

overview: Dome Peak is the glaciated centerpiece and customary high point of the famed Ptarmigan Traverse, crowning a sea of ice deep in the Glacier Peak Wilderness. Its broad summit rewards climbers with one of the great panoramas of the North Cascades.
